text:
marco: Quick ask — we need a concise PCIe vs SXM multi-GPU comparison for onboarding llm-13B quantized (q4_0/q4_1). Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, steady-state tokens/sec for 4 GPU partitions, and a capacity guide per region (us-west, eu-west). Also include NUMA pinning and NVLink on/off runs. Can someone paste charts + raw numbers?

sasha: Did a sweep this morning. Short summary: SXM+NVLink wins for long contexts (>4k) by ~30–40% p99 and ~25% throughput. For short ctx (<1k) PCIe is within ~5–10% on p50 but p99 still slightly worse. NUMA pinning helped PCIe cases more than SXM. Uploading artifacts in a sec.

infra-bot: perf-job completed: id perf-20260315-82 | artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/perf-20260315-82.tar.gz

alan: can you paste the exact command/flags you used? need to reproduce in eu-west.

sasha: sure — copied minimal harness commands I used (two topologies):

```
# PCIe run (DGX A100-ish with PCIe GPUs)
./run_multi_gpu_bench \
  --model llama-13b-q4_0 \
  --topology pcie \
  --gpus 4 \
  --batch_per_gpu 2 \
  --seq_len 2048 \
  --clients 8 \
  --pin numa0 \
  --kernels auto \
  --profile outputs/pcie-2048.json

# SXM run (DGX H100/SXM nodes with NVLink)
./run_multi_gpu_bench \
  --model llama-13b-q4_0 \
  --topology sxm \
  --gpus 4 \
  --batch_per_gpu 2 \
  --seq_len 2048 \
  --clients 8 \
  --pin numa0 \
  --nvlink on \
  --kernels fused,flash_attn \
  --profile outputs/sxm-2048.json
```

priya: Nice. Did you try disabling NVLink (force p2p off) to emulate a PCIe-like path on SXM?

sasha: yes — ran sxm with nvlink=off. Results: throughput dropped ~20% from SXM+NVLink but still ~10% better than PCIe for long context due to larger interconnect aggregate bw and kernel locality.

alan: What about NUMA pinning variations? e.g., pin to socket owning the device vs default scheduler.

sasha: NUMA notes: on PCIe nodes the GPU PCIe root complex maps to a socket; when we pinned CPU threads to the opposite socket p99 spiked up to 1.8x. Pinning to the local socket dropped p99 ~15%. On SXM nodes NUMA effect was much smaller (~3–5%) since GPUs are on a unified memory domain.

lisa: Kernel question — did you compare cuBLAS/TF32 kernels vs our fused/triton kernels for attention?

sasha: short answer: fused kernels (flash_attn-like) gave better tail latency and throughput on SXM for long sequences; cuBLAS matmuls are fine for dense earlier layers but attention fusion saves mem-bandwidth. We used kernel selector override in the harness: --kernels fused,flash_attn then fallback to cublas.

priya: for capacity sizing, what's the recommended steady-state per-4gpu throughput numbers (tokens/sec) we should expect in us-west for 2k and 8k contexts?

sasha: numbers from the profiles (llama-13b-q4_0, clients=8, batch_per_gpu=2):
- PCIe, seq=2048: tokens/sec ~ 12k (p50 28ms, p95 120ms, p99 210ms)
- SXM+NVLink, seq=2048: tokens/sec ~ 15k (p50 22ms, p95 90ms, p99 130ms)
- PCIe, seq=8192: tokens/sec ~ 4.2k (p50 110ms, p95 420ms, p99 880ms)
- SXM+NVLink, seq=8192: tokens/sec ~ 6.0k (p50 78ms, p95 320ms, p99 520ms)

NOTE: these are steady-state with KV-cache warm, and with batching tuned for latency SLOs. Raw peak flops throughput is higher when batching more aggressively.

alan: That's helpful. For EU region we often have older PCIe instances; should we prefer dedicated SXM for production-critical endpoints?

marco: If p99 is a hard requirement for canary feature, seems like SXM is worth the added capex in eu. Also NVLink and correct NUMA pinning are operational prerequisites.

priya: Any observed quality regressions with q4_0 vs q4_1 across these topologies (I assume same model binary was used)?

sasha: No topology-specific quality diffs — quantization profile (q4_0 vs q4_1) is model-internal and identical regardless of interconnect. Any small output variations were due to different kernel reorderings but not semantically relevant. We logged eval prompts; diffs < 0.5% for exact-match metrics.

infra-bot: artifacts unpacked: /artifacts/perf-20260315-82/{pcie-2048.json,sxm-2048.json,pcie-8192.json,sxm-8192.json,plots/*.png}

lisa: glanced at plots — NVLink topology graph is very clean. can we add a short note in the onboarding doc about mandatory kernel + pinning settings?

marco: yes please. @sasha can you drop a short checklist we can paste into model-onboarding.md (region-specific guidance + required flags)?

sasha: will do. Draft checklist: 1) run both PCIe and SXM baseline runs with seq lengths 512/2048/8192; 2) enable kernel selector fused,flash_attn then fallback; 3) pin worker threads to GPU-local NUMA node; 4) test NVLink on/off if available; 5) capture p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec and attach artifacts. I'll post PR to docs after lunch.

marco: perfect. thanks all. we'll use these numbers to size eu dedicated pools for the canary. :thumbsup:

lisa: :thumbsup:

alan: reproducer commands saved, will run in eu-west tonight and report back.
